summary: A local worker-document `run json` action returned valid JSON missing the declared `count` field. The run failed terminally and durable history stored exactly `activity output decode failed: Expected Field, found Nothing`, without the field path, action name, or declared type. The code preserves the decoder path in `DecodeError`, but the AWL activity-error renderer discards it; the action name is omitted from the post-dispatch carrier, and the declared type is reduced to a function-only codec before the generic renderer is called.

repro.scope: Entirely local. Built with `cargo build --workspace`. Started only processes from this clone, bound to 127.0.0.1 ports 18090, 50190, and 50191, using `/tmp/aion-issue90-repro/home`; both worker and server were killed before report creation.

fixture.workflow: A workflow `issue90_missing` declared `type Probe { ok: Bool, count: Int, note: String }`, called zero-argument action `probe() -> Probe`, and routed the result.
fixture.worker: A separate worker document for queue `issue90_local` served `probe` with `run json` and printed `{"ok":true,"note":"local"}` (valid JSON with `count` absent).

run_command_result.stderr:
error: workflow run failed: workflow 1 returned error
  details: {"tag":"AwlActivityFailed","message":"activity output decode failed: Expected Field, found Nothing"}

workflow_failed_details.message: activity output decode failed: Expected Field, found Nothing

proposed_fix.field_path: Change `gleam/aion_flow/src/aion/awl/error.gleam::describe_activity_error` so `ActivityDecodeFailed` binds and formats `path` instead of matching `_`. Reuse or extract the existing path formatting already present in `gleam/aion_flow/src/aion/internal/activity_dispatch.gleam` and define an explicit root-path rendering.
proposed_fix.action_name: Preserve the activity name past dispatch. `Activity` already contains `name` beside `output_codec`, but `Dispatched` carries only correlation ID and codec. Extend `Dispatched` with the name and enrich `ActivityDecodeFailed`, or introduce a contextual decode-failure variant before `await` returns it.
proposed_fix.declared_type: Add printable type metadata at code generation. `crates/aion-awl/src/emitter/wrappers.rs` has both `action_name` and `action.returns`, but `Codec` contains only encode/decode functions and `map_activity_error` receives only the result. Either add a display type label to `Codec`/`Activity`, or emit a contextual mapping call that receives action name and rendered return type. Apply the same scheme to ordinary calls and fan-out paths so per-action context is not lost.
proposed_fix.multiple_errors: If the smaller issue is included, replace the `[first, ..]` collapse in `dynamic_decode_error` with a representation that retains all decoder errors; this is separable from the headline fix and should have dedicated ordering/format tests.
proposed_fix.tests: Add an activity-output runtime test whose valid JSON omits a nested required field and assert that durable `AwlActivityFailed` text includes action, declared type, path, and `Expected Field, found Nothing`; also cover wrong-type, root-path, fan-out, and malformed-JSON controls.

confidence: High. I built the entire workspace successfully, ran an independently constructed worker-document reproduction against an isolated loopback server from this HEAD, observed the exact terminal text, and confirmed the same context-free message in durable `aion describe` history. I traced each loss point in source by hand. I did not implement or test a patch, and I did not test aggregation of multiple simultaneous decoder errors.
